psychological_meaning: Bleached Cedar evokes feelings of sophistication, mystery, and quiet elegance. It is often associated with introspection, creativity, and a touch of formality. This color can create a sense of calm and composure, while also suggesting a hint of intrigue and unconventional thinking. It blends the earthiness of cedar with a muted, almost ethereal quality.
